statement.zh: 乌鲁克/瓦尔卡周边 1967 年地表踏查记录了聚落—水道格局，见 Adams & Nissen《乌鲁克乡村》（1972）。
statement.en: Around Uruk/Warka, the 1967 surface reconnaissance recorded settlement–watercourse patterning, as documented in Adams & Nissen The Uruk Countryside (1972).
